sections.title: Where it all began
sections.body: My love for travel started at a young age, when my parents took me on trips around the world. From short European getaways to long adventures across the Caribbean, North America, Southeast Asia and the Middle East. This is where my curiosity for different cultures and places began to take shape.

sections.title: Traveling solo, living fully
sections.body: Today, I continue this travel journey on my own, as I now travel solo most of the time, yay! I've started to believe that life has so much more to offer than the routines and "small" lives we often settle for. There's a whole world waiting to be explored. We're here to create memories, to experience more, to live fully. That's why I decided to challenge myself: to see as much of the world as possible!

sections.title: Where creativity comes in
sections.body: Along my trips, I discovered a second passion: content creation. It has become just as important to me as traveling itself. I'm drawn to capturing the atmosphere and the small details of a place that make each trip or stay unforgettable. Creating content gives me a sense of excitement like nothing else. It allows me to relive my travels, express myself and share how I experience the world with others.

sections.title: Creating for brands & audience
sections.body: I started sharing every experience: the destinations I visit, the hotels and Airbnbs I stay in, the restaurants I discover. I started loving the idea of creating something that's not only meaningful to me, but also valuable for others. I wanted to deliver real value for brands through authentic, scroll-stopping content and, besides that, inspire my audience.

sections.title: The bigger picture
sections.body: My goal is to turn this passion into a lifestyle that feels fulfilling and entirely my own, while helping brands connect with their audience in a meaningful way and inspiring my audience to make as much memories as possible!

philosophy.label: Iris'
philosophy.headline: Philosophy
philosophy.quote: Travel is how I make the most of life. The stories I create along the way are what connect me to people, brands and the destinations I love.
